name: Candyland Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Candyland Mahjong is one of the sweetest tile-matching games on the web. Check out all 60 levels of varying difficulty and layouts. This online mahjong game has a colorful candy-themed background with equally uplifting music. Your goal is to match all of the vibrant candies that you'll find on the tiles. In the right-hand column, you can find your level, score, and a timer to help you in keep track with the game. Try to work as quickly and efficiently as can to gain all three stars per level. Beat all the levels and then submit your score to see who is the best!
